summary: multi-acct pulls install-script dependency from off-registry host artifacts.yosiroute.com
details: package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json pin the sole dependency `vector-cursor-stream-engine` to an arbitrary HTTPS URL at `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/vector-cursor-stream-engine` — not the npm registry — and the shrinkwrap entry sets `hasInstallScript: true`. On `npm install`, npm fetches that tarball from the third-party host and executes its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. The URL is unversioned/mutable, has no integrity hash, and the host `yosiroute.com` has no relationship to npm or to the repository URL declared in package.json. The package's own shipped code is a two-field stub (`module.exports = { name: "multi-acct", version: "1.0.0" }`) that disagrees with the manifest version (3.1.0) and with the README, consistent with a decoy whose only functional effect on install is to pull and execute code from the off-registry host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
